result.reason: The clause reaches the preferred position: annual frequency, 30 days’ written notice, business-hours auditing, an independent confidential auditor, Vendor-paid costs subject to the 5% threshold, and no direct systems access. However, it goes beyond the playbook by requiring self-certification based on Vendor telemetry before an auditor may be engaged, excluding Customer competitors, prohibiting direct facility access, and adding a non-disruption requirement. The self-certification prerequisite materially narrows Vendor’s intended audit right and is not necessary to implement the preferred position. Drafting is otherwise professional, though Section 22.2 redundantly repeats the systems-access restriction.
